|   |-- Extraction consumes the domain schema; deriveAnalysis computes graph projections

|-- State responsibility [O+D]: owners of extraction state and reusable facts

|   |   |-- Compiler begins in syntax mode; checker access enables semantic resolution
|   |   `-- Pin compiler inputs before releasing active compiler references

|   |-- finish() transfers facts into artifact arrays; release() clears extraction maps
|   |-- IncrementalAnalyzer owns a session checkpoint behind analyze/export/restore
|   |   `-- Reuse decision and successful assembly determine checkpoint publication
|   `-- Analyzed ownership is a separate relation vocabulary with provenance
|       `-- Creation, retention, mutation and disposal labels alone prove no lifetime
|-- Evidence contract [D]: results depend on pinned inputs and attributable facts
|   |-- Snapshot records source/configuration hashes, compiler settings and input roles
|   |-- Provenance and coverage connect emitted facts and uncertainty to pinned locations
|   |-- Git commit and dirty inputs are recorded when available; hashes also pin non-Git input
